def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.documents.add(adsk.core.DocumentTypes.FusionDesignDocumentType)
    doc.name = 'sage60_filleted_geometry_test'
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    sketch, outer_count = make_sketch(design.rootComponent, LEFT_GEOMETRY, 'TEST_LEFT_PLATE_SURFACE')
    record = {'document': doc.name, 'outer_segments': outer_count, 'lines': sketch.sketchCurves.sketchLines.count, 'arcs': sketch.sketchCurves.sketchArcs.count, 'profiles': sketch.profiles.count}
    doc.close(False)
    print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False))
